topics.title: APEC opens with major leaders meeting
topics.summary: China hosted U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, where trade, technology and global cooperation are central to the agenda.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a huge international meeting has trade and technology on the agenda, what would you most hope the leaders actually make progress on?

topics.title: Island nations press climate talks
topics.summary: Small island states at the U.N. climate conference in Turkey urged larger, wealthier countries to speed up emissions cuts and increase funding for resilience and early-warning systems.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your community had to prepare for changing weather, would you prioritize stronger buildings, better alerts, or helping neighbors organize together?

topics.title: Java security update draws attention
topics.summary: Governments and cybersecurity agencies warned organizations about a serious Java vulnerability and urged prompt software updates, highlighting how quickly everyday digital infrastructure can need attention.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is the one digital chore you keep postponing: software updates, password cleanup, backups, or sorting old photos?

topics.title: AI disclosure idea enters debate
topics.summary: U.S. officials are considering whether companies should publicly disclose use of Chinese AI models, a proposal that reflects growing questions around transparency, data practices and technology competition.
topics.discussionPrompt: When an app uses AI behind the scenes, what would you most want to know: where it came from, what data it uses, or what decisions it makes?

topics.title: AI market bets face a fresh test
topics.summary: Global stocks were mixed as investors weighed Nvidia's stronger sales outlook and awaited Anthropic's market debut, both seen as signals for confidence in the AI investment boom.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a new technology feels exciting but expensive, do you jump in early, wait for the dust to settle, or enjoy watching from the sidelines?

topics.title: Workwear brand attracts major investment
topics.summary: Permira and Freeman Spogli are acquiring a majority stake in Brunt Workwear, valuing the boots and apparel company at more than $800 million as demand for trade-focused gear grows.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes work clothes feel worth paying for: comfort, toughness, good pockets, a sharp look, or a story behind the brand?

topics.title: Luxury shoppers lean toward experiences
topics.summary: Bain expects personal luxury-goods sales to grow again in 2026, while noting that many consumers are shifting spending toward travel, dining, leisure and other premium experiences.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you had a little extra money for a treat, would you choose something you can keep or an experience you will remember?

topics.title: Government budgets face a long view
topics.summary: J.P. Morgan said developed-market fiscal deficits are on track for their highest level outside a recession since World War II, putting public spending and debt strategies in focus.
topics.discussionPrompt: When planning a household budget, is it smarter to be strict now, flexible when surprises happen, or set aside a little room for fun?

topics.title: Chip rules test the trade truce
topics.summary: New U.S. limits on advanced chip access are adding pressure to the fragile U.S.-China trade relationship, with analysts watching for possible effects on technology supply chains.
topics.discussionPrompt: When two big systems depend on each other but also compete, what usually helps most: clear rules, regular talks, or finding a shared project?

topics.title: A year in images invites reflection
topics.summary: Reuters published a visual chronicle of notable moments from 2026, looking back at a year shaped by scientific advances, major sporting events and fast-moving technology.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you made a photo album of this year so far, would it be full of big events, small everyday moments, people, places, or pets?
